title: Implement RSS 2.0 Feed Generator for Blog Posts at /feed.xml
description: Create RSS feed endpoint that generates valid RSS 2.0 XML with all published blog posts. Include auto-discovery <link> tag in HTML head for feed readers and SEO.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /feed.xml returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with Content-Type: application/rss+xml header
Feed contains all blog posts with <title>, <link>, <pubDate> (ISO 8601), <description>, and <author> elements
app/layout.tsx includes <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" href="/feed.xml"> tag in <head> for feed discovery
technicalNotes: File to create: app/api/feed/route.ts (RSS endpoint returning XML response)
File to modify: app/layout.tsx (add feed discovery link)
File to reference: lib/blog.ts (blog post metadata structure)
Test command: curl http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | grep -E '(<rss|<title|<link)' | head -10

title: Add JB News & Updates Widget to Homepage Pulling Curated RSS Feeds
description: Create homepage widget that fetches and displays latest 3 items from curated JB news RSS sources (Berita Harian, Johor Tourism Board). Implements 24-hour cache layer to prevent feed fetch failures and rate limiting.
acceptanceCriteria: Widget fetches from 3 hardcoded RSS feed URLs and parses latest 3 items with title, snippet, and publication date
Implements revalidateTag('jb-news') caching with 86400 second (24-hour) ISR revalidation window
Widget gracefully handles fetch errors and displays fallback content (e.g., 'Updates unavailable')
technicalNotes: File to create: components/JBNewsWidget.tsx (Server Component with async RSS parsing)
File to create: lib/feedparser.ts (utility to parse RSS XML and extract title/description/pubDate)
File to modify: app/page.tsx (render JBNewsWidget component in hero or below fold)
Test command: npm run dev && curl http://localhost:3000 | grep -A 5 'JB News'

title: Publish 'Getting Around JB Without a Car — Transport Guide for Backpackers' Blog Post
description: Write 1500+ word original blog post covering public transport (Rapidkuala buses), ride-hailing (Grab), taxis, and walking in Johor Bahru. Include cost comparisons, Google Maps tips, and HowTo schema for navigation. Target Malaysian workers and budget-conscious travelers.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post created at src/content/blog/getting-around-jb-without-car.tsx with >1500 words, frontmatter (title, slug, pubDate, author), and export declaration
Includes HowTo schema markup with 5+ steps for using buses, Grab, taxis, and walking
Post contains internal links to /guide, /singapore-jobs, /visa-run, and at least 2 other JB transport-related blog posts
technicalNotes: File to create: src/content/blog/getting-around-jb-without-car.tsx (TSX blog post with frontmatter)
File to modify: lib/blog.ts (import and register new post in blog post registry array)
Outline sections: Intro, Rapidkuala buses (routes/costs/passes), Taxis (call/alternatives), Grab (pricing vs Singapore), Walking neighborhoods, Google Maps tips, First-timer recommendations
Test command: npm run build && npm run dev && curl http://localhost:3000/blog/getting-around-jb-without-car | grep -i transport

title: Implement Table of Contents Auto-Generator for Blog Post Pages
description: Create TableOfContents component that auto-extracts h2/h3 headings from blog post content, generates slugified anchor IDs, and renders as sticky sidebar (desktop) or collapsible menu (mobile). Improves long-form content navigation and UX.
acceptanceCriteria: Component auto-scans React children for h2/h3 elements, extracts text content, generates slugified anchor IDs using lib/slug utility
Renders as sticky sidebar on desktop (position: sticky, top: 100px) and collapsible accordion on mobile (max-width: 768px)
Clicking TOC items scrolls to corresponding heading with smooth scroll-behavior: smooth CSS property
technicalNotes: File to create: components/TableOfContents.tsx (React component with useEffect DOM scanning and scroll listener)
File to create: lib/slug.ts (slugify function: lowercase, replace spaces/symbols with hyphens)
File to modify: app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (wrap blog content with <TableOfContents> wrapper component)
Test command: npm run dev && navigate to blog post && click TOC items && verify smooth scroll to headings

title: Update sitemap.ts to Include All Published Blog Post URLs with Metadata
description: Modify app/sitemap.ts to dynamically enumerate all blog posts from lib/blog.ts and generate <url> entries with lastmod (ISO 8601), changefreq: weekly, and priority: 0.8. Ensures all blog content is discoverable by search engines.
acceptanceCriteria: sitemap.ts imports blog post array from lib/blog.ts and maps each post to a Sitemap URL entry with loc, lastmod, changefreq, priority
Each blog URL includes correct <lastmod> (post.pubDate in ISO 8601), <changefreq>weekly</changefreq>, <priority>0.8</priority>
Total URL count in /sitemap.xml increases from current count to >25 URLs (verifiable via grep <url> count)
technicalNotes: File to modify: app/sitemap.ts (add blog post enumeration before return statement)
File to reference: lib/blog.ts (import blog post array and extract slug, pubDate metadata)
Example entry: { url: 'https://pelangi-capsule-hostel.com/blog/getting-around-jb', lastmod: new Date('2026-04-14').toISOString(), changefreq: 'weekly', priority: 0.8 }
Test command: curl http://localhost:3000/sitemap.xml | grep -c '<url>' && curl http://localhost:3000/sitemap.xml | grep 'blog/'
